item.title: Obituary - Wilma Louise Reeves
item.description: Wilma Louise Reeves, age 89, of Mound City, Kansas passed away Thursday, December 18, 2025. She was born on July 3, 1936 in Amoret, Missouri to Nelson and Bessie Cole. She graduated from Miami Rural High School and then attended Central Business College in Kansas City, Missouri where she met her husband, James Merle Reeves. item.description: Debra “Debby” Lee Jones, age 73 of Nevada, MO, passed away on Sunday, December 14, 2025, at Freeman Hospital West, in Joplin, MO. item.title: 20 new phlebotomists graduate at Cass Career Center
item.description: Hey Cass County — we have TWENTY new phlebotomists! These seniors from Archie School District, Belton School District #124, Drexel, Harrisonville High School, Lone Jack Middle and High School, Midway R-I School, and Pleasant Hill R-3 School District accomplished this incredible milestone while also participating in advanced internships this semester. That's a 100% pass rate for Cass Advanced Health Services!

item.title: Structure fire in Archie
